package ansiedit // import "ubunatic.com/loom/examples/ansiedit/ansiedit"

Package ansiedit is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

CONSTANTS

const (
	ModeOvertype = loom.AnsiModeOvertype
	ModeInsert   = loom.AnsiModeInsert
)

FUNCTIONS

func NewWidget(args []string) (loom.Widget, error)
    NewWidget builds the ansiedit root widget for in-process hosting.

func Run(args []string) error
    Run executes the ansiedit interactive editor command.


TYPES

type AnsiEditApp struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    AnsiEditApp is the root ANSI editor application widget.

func NewAnsiEditApp(buf *Buffer) *AnsiEditApp
    NewAnsiEditApp creates a new AnsiEditApp instance for a given buffer.

func (app *AnsiEditApp) Buffer() *Buffer
    Buffer returns the underlying buffer.

func (app *AnsiEditApp) ConsumeKey(e loom.KeyEvent) loom.EventResult
    ConsumeKey processes keyboard events, returning an EventResult value struct.
    Navigation and editing keys are consumed without quitting. Explicit exit
    keys (F10, Ctrl-Q) signal quit.

func (app *AnsiEditApp) ConsumeMouse(e loom.MouseEvent) loom.EventResult
    ConsumeMouse handles mouse clicks.

func (app *AnsiEditApp) Draw(c *loom.Canvas, r loom.Rect)
    Draw renders the full 80x24 AnsiEdit frame and all subcomponents.

func (app *AnsiEditApp) PaneRequest() loom.PaneRequest
    PaneRequest declares terminal requirements.

func (app *AnsiEditApp) Quit() bool
    Quit reports whether the application has received a quit signal.

type Buffer = loom.AnsiBuffer
    Buffer is an in-memory 2D cell grid for ANSI art editing.

func LoadBuffer(path string, defaultCols, defaultRows int) (*Buffer, error)
    LoadBuffer reads an ANSI file and parses it into a 2D Buffer.

func NewBuffer(cols, rows int) *Buffer
    NewBuffer creates an empty ANSI buffer with the specified columns and rows.

func ParseBuffer(content string, minCols, minRows int) (*Buffer, error)
    ParseBuffer parses an ANSI string into a 2D Buffer.

type BufferCell = loom.AnsiCell
    BufferCell represents a single styled character cell in the ANSI canvas
    buffer.

func BlankCell() BufferCell
    BlankCell returns a default empty cell.

type EditMode = loom.AnsiEditMode
    EditMode represents character insertion vs overtype behavior.

type FocusArea int
    FocusArea denotes which panel currently possesses user keyboard focus.

const (
	FocusCanvas FocusArea = iota
	FocusSidePanel
)
func (f FocusArea) String() string

type SidePanelMode int
    SidePanelMode determines the active view in the left side panel.

const (
	PanelInfo SidePanelMode = iota
	PanelPalette
	PanelKeys
	PanelTheme
)
func (m SidePanelMode) String() string
